taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: stems 1 cm to 3 cm high, each with one flower; the flower, its petals 2 cm to 2.5 cm long, stands above them, so set to 7 cm at most for the plant in flower.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: a perennial from a stout branching root and a short caudex.

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: leaves all basal.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: leaves 2 cm to 5 cm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: leaves broadly linear or narrowly club-shaped, blunt and very fleshy.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Hairless and fleshy, as the photos show: Abrams (1944 p. 135) names no hairs.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: each stem bears one flower.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: petals 2 cm to 2.5 cm long.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: petals 2 cm to 2.5 cm long, spreading, so the flower about twice that across.

traits.perianth.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: 4 to 8 sepals and 12 to 18 petals.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: 12 to 18 petals; drawn as 12, the most a flower is drawn with.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: petals rose-coloured, sometimes white; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.stamens.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: 35 to 50 stamens.

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: a capsule 5 mm to 6 mm high.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944) p. 135, Lewisia rediviva: flowering March to June.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: short reddish stalks; fleshy, club-shaped grey-green leaves.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for bitterroot from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite: the herb program's structure (stems, nodes, basal leaves, how the flowers are borne). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.03 m tall at 3 years in the open, within the flora's range. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
